documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015- ESG Rating

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with standalone and consolidated revenue growth, supported by export sales momentum, particularly in the US. Management noted ongoing market volatility, raw material price fluctuations, and elevated shipping costs, while maintaining a long-term revenue growth outlook of 10% to 15%. The company is executing a capacity expansion in its current premises to be operational by early 2027 and continues evaluating potential international manufacturing locations. Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results, highlighting year-on-year revenue growth alongside higher PBT and PAT on both standalone and consolidated bases. Management discussed robust growth in the export and automotive OEM segments, while noting that polyurethane (PU) business remains muted with commercial settlements pending.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth between 8% to 10% and export growth between 15% to 20% in value.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: The management has kept a potential outlook for a 15% growth in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the value growth is projected at 15% on average for the next 2 years.
guidance.quote: Sir, I have told you to go up by 15% on average and calculate the margin saving, then you will get a clear idea.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the footwear segment experienced a degrowth in the last quarter due to drastic increases in raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So specifically, our footwear business, because you have to understand the price of raw material for footwear, not only the PVC prices, the sole prices increased drastically to -- it went up to almost like 2x, 3x last year -- sorry, in the last quarter. So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees the FTA signed by India as a very positive move that will increase cost effectiveness and customer procurement sentiments from India.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the polyurethane business remains muted at present with sales not increasing significantly.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the European automotive industry is experiencing degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that plasticizer and yarn prices have started going up.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered a new production line for its current premises to start production by February or March 2027 with an additional capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex planned for the financial year 2026-2027 is around INR 50 crores.
The company ordered a coating line and found space in an existing facility instead of putting it in South India.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here. So, our capacity will increase. But we are not putting it in South India. We are putting it here.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for a global location is estimated around 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: A global scale capex would be INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Once a decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

capex_expansion.claim: The initial capacity for the South plant will start with 500,000 millimetres per month.
capex_expansion.quote: And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

capex_expansion.claim: The expansion currently being discussed is for a PVC plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes. Whatever you're talking about expansion right now is about the PVC plant.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that a sustainable margin is 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Shipment costs increased significantly by 4x during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for paste PVC went up significantly as a petroleum by-product, presenting initial challenges in March.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have softened a little bit from the highs of March and availability is not an issue right now.
margins_costs.quote: And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March. It's softened a little bit. But availability is not an issue right now.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses decreased in the quarter due to lower freight costs and controlled maintenance and consumable costs.
margins_costs.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled and because of these two reasons our other income reduced

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that product mix, raw material prices, and operating activity improvements contributed to margin gains.
margins_costs.quote: So, basically the product mix of export market, our raw material prices and definitely improvement in our operating activity has contributed to the improvement in margin.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 50% of other income for the quarter came from foreign exchange gains.
margins_costs.quote: Yes. This quarter, other income has the major part of foreign exchange gain around 50% and remaining is our treasury income.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold a total volume of 31 million meters in FY26.
Total volume for the quarter was 76.3 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted volatility in the market due to Trump tariffs, the West Asia war, and multiple other events affecting plant location decisions.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Short-term impact on domestic business can occur because it takes time to pass on raw material price increases to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management acknowledged that cheap imports and manipulation from China are present in the market.
risks_headwinds.quote: A lot of cheap imports are coming from China. There's a lot of manipulation.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the newly ordered expansion line in current premises is expected to start between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects increased momentum in export OEM supply from the US to continue in the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And in addition to this, we have already received some good export orders from US for OEM supply which are making a good contribution to our self-revenue and profitability. And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The newly ordered coating line for the existing location should be installed by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the increased export momentum is expected to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
